cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Costume inspection. Unlock the cupboard, please; I've pinned on a badge like yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wore mine to play a policeman. Who sent you? The cupboard's locked because of moths.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, costume badges. Let's look at the moth damage before it spreads.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get the wardrobe manager. She'll ask who authorized your inspection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her I'm here to help with the moths. Show her the damage first; we can do introductions afterwards.
